verdict.rationale: The pack documents Serverless autoscaling, where resources follow actual usage and spikes get more resources. That describes resource elasticity, not a pricing model, so it is adjacent at best. Nothing in the pack describes how costs scale with record count or query volume, or confirms the absence of per-request charges or cost caps. Community comments call Elastic expensive but do not address whether costs are predictable.

support.subject: As a founder, costs stay predictable as records and query volume grow — no surprise per-request cliffs
